findings.evaluation: OLMES RC answer-text teacher forcing; raw and per-character accuracy will both be reported.
findings.selector: Layerwise greedy probability mean after pruning previous layers, not full-native one-pass prefix ranking.
findings.our_data: Official dev5 / complete validation / seeded 64 test per subject; not paper full-table resplit.
findings.actual_code_resplit: GenericMMLU_withsplits TEST_FRACTION=.6 uses first60% test as train, rest40% as test. This pilot does not claim exact reproduction of that split.
findings.our_numeric_program: BF16 masked-gate representation, FP32 probability aggregation, not literal row-pruned GEMM kernels; native controls and scope required.
